text:
Maya: quick micro-audit of rerank export UX from QA run — a few separate nits: (1) CTA copy unclear (does export include metadata?), (2) large-exports block UI with no progress, (3) tiny relevance chips on compact rows are low contrast, (4) truncated metadata has no affordance. Screenshot attached.

design-bot: build-5133 snapshot: https://ci/internal/5133/shot.png

Olivia: Re: CTA copy  agree it's ambiguous. Recommend primary: "Download CSV (id,embedding,metadata)" and secondary: "Download NDJSON (for eval)". Keep primary action prominent. Tooltip shows sample header.

Jamal: Front-end note: split-button is straightforward. Will add sample header preview in tooltip and show final filename preview before download.

Ankur: a11y: add aria-describedby to the CTA with short text: "Includes id, embedding values, and metadata columns. Choose NDJSON for newline-delimited pipelines." Also ensure keyboard shortcut D downloads focused item. Announce via sr-only hint on preview open.

Zane: Analytics: track event export_initiated with props {format,compress,rows_selected,workspace}. Folks find filenames useful for pipeline automation so include workspace and date.

Maya: big export behavior: if rows > 50k we should enqueue and show progress panel + notification with link. Do not block main UI.

Jamal: yes  implement async export flow: small exports download immediately; heavy exports create job, UI shows progress toast and console notification, email optional. API param: async_threshold=50000.

Olivia: visual: relevance chips in dark theme use #6B7280 text on translucent bg  fails contrast. Propose text #E5E7EB and pill-bg rgba(255,255,255,0.06) -> 0.08; also increase min hit area to 14px.

Ankur: chips are small; 4.5:1 requirement means we should either bump font to 13px or use stronger text color. Also add aria-label like "Relevance score: 0.92" for screen readers.

Maya: truncated metadata keys: add title attribute and hover tooltip; for SR users include visually-hidden full key. Also allow clicking cell to copy full metadata JSON.

Jamal: will add ellipsis+title and a copy action on long-press/hover for desktop, long-press menu for touch. Also add a "Copy row as NDJSON" action in row menu.

Zane: for filenames let's default to: vectors-<workspace>-YYYYMMDD[.ndjson|.csv|.ndjson.gz]. Allow user prefix and show final example under the input. Track user override in analytics.

Olivia: tiny UX: when table density toggles, action column shifts and keyboard focus can get lost. Keep action column width stable and hide labels into hover popover to avoid reflow.

Ankur: ensure sort header uses aria-sort and announcer updates: "Sorted by relevance, descending". Also debounce live updates to relevance to avoid spammy announcements.

Maya: thanks. can we get a tiny mock with split button copy + sample header + filename preview + pill color change? also add a small test plan for accessibility and export job flow.

Jamal: will push PR with mock + a11y checklist + async export job in API doc by tomorrow AM.

Olivia: I'll add the mock comments and a short checklist: contrast, aria-sort, aria-describedby on CTA, initial focus on preview title, keyboard D/Shift+D, title tooltips for truncation.

Maya: perfect. after PR we do a quick 3-person accessibility smoke and close. :thumbsup:
